```{r load}
ov_data <-
  read_rds(paste0(here(), 
                  "/data/processed_data",
                  # path_gillis, "/ProcessedData",
                  "/CHinOvary_FinalClinicalData_20261009.rds")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  mutate(ch_status = factor(ch_status, levels = c("No CH", "CH"))) %>% 
  mutate(tich_status = case_when(
    ch_status == "No CH"                               ~ "No CH",
    ch_status == "CH" & 
      tumor_ch_status == "At least 1 CH in tumor"      ~ "TI-CH",
    ch_status == "CH" & 
      tumor_ch_status == "No CH in Tumor"              ~ "CH only in blood"
  ), tich_status = factor(tich_status, levels = c("No CH", "TI-CH", "CH only in blood")))
  
pfs_data <-
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(here(), 
                           "/data/data_review",
                           # path_gillis, "/ProcessedData",
                           "/PFS_OS_CaseReview_20261001.xlsx"))
medication_data <-
  read_rds(paste0(here(), 
                  "/data/processed_data",
                  "/All_PatientsMedication_LongFormat_20261009.rds"))
ovca_medication_data <-
  read_rds(paste0(here(), 
                  "/data/processed_data",
                  "/OVCA_PatientsMedication_LongFormat_20261009.rds"))
# path_raw <- fs::path("", "Volumes", "Lab_Gillis",
#                      "ORIEN_Avatar", "resources")
# load("~/Documents/GitHub/Gillis/ch_orien/Rmd/R01 Gillis-Teng 2023-2024/initial_files.RData")

ov_data <- ov_data %>% 
  select(-c(germline_wes, tumor_wes, disease_type,
            number_of_blood_variants, number_of_tumor_variants,
            germline_kit, wes_batch, site,
            age_at_clinical_record_creation, year_of_clinical_record_creation))
```

```{r update PFS}
ovarian_data <- pfs_data %>% 
  filter(updated_results == "exclude") |> 
  select(avatar_key, updated_results, reason_exclusion_pfs) %>%
  full_join(ov_data, ., by = "avatar_key") %>% 
  # Completely remove patient with "older than 90" record
  filter(reason_exclusion_pfs != "older than 90" |
           is.na(reason_exclusion_pfs)) |> 
  # Replace potential missing time and event data for excluded 
  mutate_at(c("pfs_event", "pfs_age",
              "pfs_time_from_dx_years",
              "pfs_time_from_treatment_years",
              "rfs_event", "rfs_age",
              "rfs_time_from_dx_years",
              "rfs_time_from_treatment_years"), ~ case_when(
                updated_results == "exclude"                     ~ NA_real_,
                TRUE                                             ~ .
              )) |> 
  select(-c(updated_results, reason_exclusion_pfs)) |> 
  # Censor at 10 years
  mutate(os_event_10y_cens = case_when(
    os_time_from_treatment_years <= 10                         ~ os_event,
    os_time_from_treatment_years > 10                          ~ 0,
    TRUE                                                       ~ NA_real_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(pfs_event_10y_cens = case_when(
    pfs_time_from_treatment_years <= 10                        ~ pfs_event,
    pfs_time_from_treatment_years > 10                         ~ 0,
    TRUE                                                       ~ NA_real_
  )) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(os_time_from_dx_years, 
                  os_time_from_treatment_years,
                  pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
                  rfs_time_from_treatment_years), ~ case_when(
                    . <= 10                                                    ~ .,
                    . > 10                                                     ~ 10,
                    TRUE                                                       ~ NA_real_
                  ), .names = "{.col}_10y_cens")) %>% 
  # Drugs/Radiation sequence vars
  mutate(treatment_sequence_surgery_excluded = case_when(
    is.na(has_medication_data)                             ~ NA_character_,
    is.na(has_radiation_data)                              ~ NA_character_,
    age_at_med_start_1 <= age_at_radiation_start_1               ~ "drug/rad",
    age_at_med_start_1 > age_at_radiation_start_1                ~ "rad/drug",
    drug_ever == "No" &
      radiation_ever == "No"                               ~ "No drug or radiation",
    drug_ever == "Yes" &
      radiation_ever == "No"                               ~ "drug only",
    radiation_ever == "Yes" &
      drug_ever == "No"                                    ~ "radiation only",
    is.na(age_at_med_start_1) &
      is.na(age_at_radiation_start_1)                         ~ "missing drug and rad age",
    is.na(age_at_med_start_1)                                 ~ "missing drug age",
    is.na(age_at_radiation_start_1)                           ~ "missing rad age",
    TRUE      ~ paste(age_at_med_start_1, age_at_radiation_start_1, sep = "; ")
  )) |> 
  mutate(first_treatment_surgery_excluded = case_when(
    str_detect(treatment_sequence_surgery_excluded, "^rad")    ~ "Radiation",
    str_detect(treatment_sequence_surgery_excluded, "^drug")   ~ "Drugs",
  )) |> 
  mutate(age_at_first_drug_or_rad = case_when(
    first_treatment_surgery_excluded == "Radiation"            ~ age_at_radiation_start_1,
    first_treatment_surgery_excluded == "Drugs"                ~ age_at_med_start_1
  )) %>% 
  # Blood variable
  mutate(blood_sequence = case_when(
    germline_collection_age <= age_at_med_start_1 &
      germline_collection_age <= age_at_radiation_start_1      ~ "blood before drug/radiation",
    germline_collection_age > age_at_med_start_1 &
      germline_collection_age > age_at_radiation_start_1       ~ "blood after drug/radiation",
    
    germline_collection_age > age_at_med_start_1 &
      germline_collection_age <= age_at_radiation_start_1       ~ "drug > blood > radiation",
    germline_collection_age <= age_at_med_start_1 &
      germline_collection_age > age_at_radiation_start_1        ~ "radiation > blood > drug",
    
    drug_ever == "No" &
      radiation_ever == "No"                                   ~ "No drug or radiation",
    drug_ever == "Yes" &
      radiation_ever == "No" &
      (germline_collection_age <= age_at_med_start_1)          ~ "blood before drug",
    drug_ever == "Yes" &
      radiation_ever == "No" &
      (germline_collection_age > age_at_med_start_1)           ~ "blood after drug",
    radiation_ever == "Yes" &
      drug_ever == "No" &
      (germline_collection_age <= age_at_radiation_start_1 )   ~ "blood before radiation",
    radiation_ever == "Yes" &
      drug_ever == "No" &
      (germline_collection_age > age_at_radiation_start_1 )    ~ "blood after radiation",
    is.na(age_at_med_start_1) &
      is.na(age_at_radiation_start_1)                             ~ "missing drug and rad age",
    is.na(age_at_med_start_1)                                     ~ "missing drug age",
    is.na(age_at_radiation_start_1)                               ~ "missing rad age",
  )) %>% 
  mutate(time_blood_to_first_drugrad_days = (germline_collection_age - age_at_first_drug_or_rad) * 365)

a <- ovarian_data |> select(avatar_key, blood_sequence, time_blood_to_first_drugrad_days, 
                            germline_collection_age, age_at_first_drug_or_rad,
                            first_treatment_surgery_excluded, treatment_sequence_surgery_excluded, age_at_med_start_1,
                            age_at_radiation_start_1, germline_collection_age)

b <- a |> filter(blood_sequence == "blood before drug")
```

<br>

Note: 

A total of 560 patients had both a blood sample and a tumor sample collected and were identified as having a disease type of "GYN – Ovarian Cancer". From those, patients were excluded if they had:

- a primary site recorded as "Endometrium";
- a non-epithelial ovarian cancer diagnosis;
- a rare ovarian tumor;
- all recorded ages noted as "older than 90".

After applying these exclusion criteria, `r nrow(ovarian_data)` patients remained in the final study cohort. 
<br>

# Patient characteristics
I asked Kavita, to code stage they take the maximun values from ClinGroupStage and GradePathological. 
No FIGO stage listed anywhere.   
BMI is selected to be the closest to Dx (before or after).
But in case of ovarian cancer for which patient often receive surgery, should I take only BMI before Dx.
Or make a rule depending if patient received surgery?
```{r Patient characteristics}
ovarian_data %>%
  select(age_at_diagnosis,
         # not_real_age, #not_real_sequencing_age,
         race, ethnicity,
         raceeth,
         histotype, grade,
         hgsoc_vs_others, stage_cat, stage,
         # ecog, karnofsky,
         bmi, bmi_cat,
         smoking_status,
         upfront_treatment,
         treatment_sequence,
         blood_sequence, 
         time_blood_to_first_drugrad_days,
         time_dx_to_first_treatment_days,
         vital_status,
         os_event, os_time_from_treatment_years,
         os_event_10y_cens, os_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
         pfs_event, pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         pfs_event_10y_cens, pfs_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
         ch_status, tumor_ch_status
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              type = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical")#,
              # sort = list(all_categorical() ~ "frequency")
              ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t=0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  # add_stat_label() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```

# Survival

For PFS I have "Progression" and "Recurrence", both are coded as event = 1.
For PFS event == 1, I use AgeAtProgRecur, and for pfs event == 0, I use AgeAtCurrentDiseaseStatus which is more accurate.
Patients who don't have info for PFS but have info for OS are not included into PFS coding as we are not sure if the patient had been seen/had a progression before their date of death/date of last contact.

## OS
Median OS in years
```{r Median OS}
survfit(Surv(time = ovarian_data$os_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
                   event = ovarian_data$os_event_10y_cens) ~ 1,
              data = ovarian_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
survfit(Surv(time = ovarian_data$os_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
                   event = ovarian_data$os_event_10y_cens) ~ ch_status,
              data = ovarian_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
```

# Sensitivity analysis in HGSC
```{r HGSC}
ovarian_data <- ovarian_data %>%
  filter(hgsoc_vs_others == "High-grade serous/carcinosarcoma")
```
We have `r nrow(ovarian_data)` patients.

## Patient characteristics
```{r Patient characteristics HGSC}
ovarian_data %>% 
  select(age_at_diagnosis,
         # not_real_age, #not_real_sequencing_age,
         race, ethnicity,
         raceeth,
         histotype, grade,
         hgsoc_vs_others, stage_cat, stage,
         # ecog, karnofsky,
         bmi, bmi_cat,
         smoking_status,
         first_treatment,
         blood_sequence,
         time_blood_to_first_drugrad_days,
         time_dx_to_first_treatment_days,
         vital_status,
         os_event, os_time_from_treatment_years,
         os_event_10y_cens, os_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
         pfs_event, pfs_time_from_treatment_years,
         pfs_event_10y_cens, pfs_time_from_treatment_years_10y_cens,
         ch_status, tumor_ch_status
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              type = list(all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical")#,
              # sort = list(all_categorical() ~ "frequency")
              ) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t=0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  # add_stat_label() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```
